cast.characterName: アプローズ=E=ランドルフ
cast.originalCharacterName: アプローズ=E=ランドルフ

segments.text: "Please allow me to serve you with sincere devotion."
The eldest daughter of the former Duke Randolph. For a certain reason, her family escaped from Rowan, and lived in a village deep in the mountains.

As a result of her family, and all those around her being murdered, she vows to take revenge on those who took everything from her. She now always carries herself with a face void of emotion. In her pursuit of revenge, she makes a contract with Oberon to strengthen her faesight hand.
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: エドワード バーンスタイン
cast.originalCharacterName: エドワード バーンスタイン

segments.text: "Once again, welcome to the House Bernstein. If you have any issues, don't hesitate to come to me."

The next head of the Bernstein house, descendants of the Sylph. An honest, fair and calm person. With the pride and determination of a noble, he believes those with power should aid those who don’t share the same privilege.
He always addresses people politely no matter who it is, and dislikes conflict. He has a deep respect, and is very loyal to the Queen, but he’s against the discrimination of the mingles.
"Even if I were no longer Edward Bernstein, cut off from my family and duties, I would still love the wind."

He protects the anxious citizens, and keeps the peace by driving out wing hunters. To help him accomplish more, our protagonist becomes involved in aiding Eden, where the lower class lives. She uses this opportunity to become closer to him.
As she watches the always kind, always honest Edward be troubled by the country’s rampant discrimination and his conflicts with his father, she slowly begins to reveal her heart to him...
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: アルフレッド クレスウェル
cast.originalCharacterName: アルフレッド クレスウェル

segments.text: "Listening to the thoughts of those who call this country home is part of my duty. I'm glad I got to hear what you had to say today."
The present head of the Creswell house, descendant of the Spriggan. A serious and strict person. Always thinking one step ahead, he’s the typical adviser type who speaks logically.
He can show signs of brittleness if things suddenly don’t go the way he expected, and sometimes finds himself putting on a bold front. He’s the type of person to use anything at his disposal.
He’s concerned about the future of the country, and the weakening existence of the mingles.
"I believe you have opinions about the Five Houses—perhaps even this nation as a whole. If that’s the case then we can surely work together, can't we?"
Alfred is trying to bring together other talented workers and encouraging them to work together.
After having the chance to make conversation with him on many occasions, the protagonist begins to suspect that Alfred is looking into her.
One day, the protagonist sees him sneaking around town, disguised. Finding that strange, she follows him, only to discover his unexpected true identity...
From Aksys Games
"I'm the problem. Your aura's a little... similar to a girl I got to know a long time ago."
The next head of the Ward house, descendants of the Cu Sith. Always lifting up the mood with his bright and friendly personality.

He loves his clan (family), but doesn’t forget those who hurt his inner circle. Once immersed in his job, he forgets to sleep and eat. His one and only complex stems from the fact that when he uses his abilities, animal ears appear on his head. He can't forget his first love, and romance plays a passive role in his life.
"I keep doing it, but recalling her... isn't pleasant for me either. From now on, I'll make sure never to talk of her in front of you."

Our protagonist feels it might be too risky to stay close to Linus, who shows no mercy to anyone with anti-Queen sentiments. However, after being impressed with her inadvertent display of self-defense, he asks her to come with him on his missions. As she spends more time with him, his regrets and conflicts towards his lineage become more clear, and she learns more about his unforgettable first love.
And when it becomes clear for our protagonist that he's going to be an unavoidable obstacle in her goal for revenge...
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: ルーカス サリヴァン
cast.originalCharacterName: ルーカス サリヴァン

segments.text: "How I spend my time is none of your business. And I can prepare a carriage myself. Leave me alone.
The expected head of the Sullivan house, descendants of the Will-o'-Wisp. An odd pessimist who won’t hesitate to announce his desires to become a purefae.
He's a noble, but he detests political strife, and has a cold manner of speaking when talking to others. He shows a kinder side of himself to those he's close to, but he can become belligerent.
"Purefae are the only flawless existences in this world. If I could become one and go to Tir na nOg, don't you think I'd be freed from all the nonsensical shackles dragging us down?"

When his only servant brought to Rowan for the meeting collapses, our protagonist finds herself being suddenly sent to the Sullivan townhouse from the Bernstein residence. As she searches the residence while being influenced by his strange actions, her suspicion that he was involved in the incident from 8 years ago grows stronger.
On the other hand, as she experiences his kindness and learns about his childhood, a sense of trust also starts growing inside her. But when she suddenly learns what he's hiding...
From Aksys Games
"It's just that you look like a kitten with its fur standing on end, all tense and on guard."
The representative head of the Lindel house, descendants of the Puca. A handsome young man with the reputation of a womanizer in high society, he tends to be idolized by women, and detested by men.
Despite working as the representative head, he doesn't take his work seriously. Even when he's reprimanded, he slips away and does as he pleases.
"Fear not. I have no intention of revealing your goals to anyone. As long as you take my hand, that is."

Thinking she could use Ascot's charmer tendencies to her advantage, our protagonist is warned by John and Goneril that such an endeavor may be too large of a responsibility. As she spends her days unconvinced it may be an issue, Ascost suggests they pretend to be lovers, and despite pretending to understand his reasoning, she can't grasp his true intentions.
Fully aware of the risks, she takes Ascot's hand and pretends to be his lover as a way to get closer to the Queen. But as they spend more and more time together...
From Aksys Games
"Focus on your own safety. You're the one who's the most at risk here."
Aprose's attendant and childhood friend who diligently accomplishes any task without error. Being skilled at both literary and military arts, he drilled self-defense techniques into Aprose.
While normally quiet, he sometimes finds himself being protective of Aprose, and strongly scolding her. He's always cautious and studies his surroundings as he aids our protagonist with her revenge.
"When you say you're okay, you're actually not. As long as I remember that, there's no issue."

As our protagonist goes undercover, she parts ways from John, who'd always been by her side, keeping her safe. During that time, when she visits the palace again as Lilly’s retainer, she runs into John, who is anxiously undercover as a waiter at the party venue. After a brief moment of peace, she encounters a suspicious man, which leads her to learn about the turmoil that the country finds itself in.
Then as a result of a dream she had, the trust she has in John gradually begins to change...
From Aksys Games
"You will come with me, yes? That's why you came all the way here, yes?!"
A romantic who loves cute things. While she rules over the fae, her love towards Humanies has become stronger than her love towards the fae. This difference has become stronger over the years.
As a result of becoming older, she's started to show a more ruthless side. She tends to feel lonely quite easily. She ceased all communications with Oberon after taking his wings.
From Aksys Games
"This is why you're still a child. You don't understand a woman's heart. All you care about is what's on the outside. You'll never be popular like that."
He's a moody, self-centered non-human. He loves Tia, but after having his wings taken, his great love turned to great hate.
He doesn't care about anyone else but Tia.
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: エドマンド＝バーンスタイン
cast.originalCharacterName: エドマンド＝バーンスタイン

segments.text: "Power is all that matters, Edward. If you don't understand that, then you have no business inheriting this household."

The current head of the Bernstein house, and Edward and Lilly's father. He's incredibly loyal to the Queen. A stern meritocrat, he often quarrels with his son, who he thinks would be a weak successor to the house.
He's fully prepared to become a stepping stone in the mission to create a world where the weak have been weeded out, and only the strong exist.
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: リリー＝バーンスタイン
cast.originalCharacterName: リリー＝バーンスタイン

segments.text: "I'm not as unfortunate as everyone believes. Because he's always here... in my heart."
The young daughter of the House Bernstein, and Edward's sister. A beautiful, refined and modest woman, nicknamed "Madonna Lily" in high society.

She spends her days wondering how she can end the friction that exists between her father Edmund and her brother Edward. She ran away with her beloved and eloped, but after his death, she returned to her family's home.
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: ニコラス＝ヘンダーソン
cast.originalCharacterName: ニコラス＝ヘンダーソン

segments.text: "Members of the Five Houses will be here today. Stay focused and ready to take on your tasks, everyone."
The elderly butler who manages the Bernstein residence. He's adaptive and calm when accomplishing his tasks and is very strict when it comes to his work.

He has absolute loyalty towards Edmund, the head of the house, and his benefactor, and has no forgiveness for those who are looking to cause him any harm. His only weakness is his wife, who he's completely outclassed by.
From Aksys Games
"I won't be going easy on you just because you're new, you know."
The parlor maid who works for the House Bernstein. She's very frank, fast and thorough when it comes to her work. She’s trusted by Nicholas.

She wants to attain the status the upper class hold, but doesn't let herself get carried away by odd dreams, and reliably focuses on accomplishing her tasks. Living in a class-based society, she's against the discrimination she sees around her, but she doesn't voice her thoughts on the matter.
She's almost the same age as Charlotte, and the both of them get along well.
From Aksys Games
"You had this really intense look on your face. Is something bothering you...?"
The kitchen maid who works for the House Bernstein. Considering her timidness, she has a low self-assessment of herself when it comes to everything.
She tends to hide behind her fellow servants, but every now and again she'll voice her sharp thoughts on a matter (she doesn't mean any harm). She's a skilled cook, praised by her fellow servants.
She used to be employed by House Creswell, but was expelled due to her lack of powers.
From Aksys Games

cast.characterName: フィリップ＝オルティス
cast.originalCharacterName: フィリップ＝オルティス

segments.text: "If you're looking for romance, you have to fall in love with someone of the same social status. Like me, for example!"
A butler in training for House Bernstein. An easy going, cheerful person who tends to get carried away easily, but he’s actually well composed, and highly values loyalty.
He's the type of person to devote himself to the one thing he decides to focus on. Although they have different masters, Nicholas empathizes with his sense of loyalty, and looks after him.
From Aksys Games
"Heehee. Too much of a bother to talk about it, eh? I can hear you out if you have any worries."

A well known skilled informant in the underworld, the information she possesses covers a wide range of topics. From the total sales an Eden bakery made that day, to the opera house secret meetings, she sells all kinds of information for the right price.
Goneril is a false name she's given herself. No one knows her real name. She also loves teasing people.
From Aksys Games
"Rowan is such a big city, don't you think? One day, I'd like to take you here again when you're free—"
The successor to House Randolph and Aprose's older brother. He was loved by those around him due to his mischievous and kind nature.

He treasured his younger sister, to the point of being excessively attached, but every now and then he took a strict attitude with her when it was for her sake. He was always thinking about how he wanted his younger sister to have a better fate.
From Aksys Games
"What business d'you have here? If you wanna go any further, you need my approval first. That's the rule."
A boy who lives in Eden. He acts as a sort of leader to the other children who've fallen in the same fate as him. He bustles about with a tenacious attitude to make ends meet.
He's connected to someone within one of the five houses.
From Aksys Games
